proves.claim: nextFor never offers an open item whose needs the seat abilities lack, offers it to a seat that has them, and offers an item with no needs as before.

store.io-board-next.needs-ability-skips.why: Without this test, a regression where nextFor never offers an open item whose needs the seat abilities lack, offers it to a seat that has them, and offers an item with no needs as before would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: with observeIdle the item skipped for a missing ability is listed with code NEEDS_ABILITY.

store.io-board-next.needs-ability-idle-s.why: Without this test, a regression where with observeIdle the item skipped for a missing ability is listed with code NEEDS_ABILITY would pass unnoticed.
